mode: Built-in image generation; reference-guided sprite sheets

groups.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: evenly spaced food-icon SPRITE SHEET for Sikurepi. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not an edit target. Create ONE high-resolution landscape 5:3 transparent PNG sheet with EXACTLY 15 different dish icons in a STRICT 5 COLUMN by 3 ROW uniform grid, equal square cells. Request 3000x1800 pixels if possible. Each complete plate/bowl is centered at the exact center of its cell, occupies no more than 75% of cell width and height, separated from ALL cell boundaries by fully transparent generous gutters. No overlaps, no missing cells, no extras, no text/labels/numbers, no drawn grid, no external drop shadows. Genuine transparent alpha background throughout, not white or fake checkerboard. Warm polished cute hand-painted illustration matching reference, dark-brown contours, appetizing colors, consistent three-quarter view. Each plate/bowl has two black eyes, small smile and pink cheeks at the front. Keep each listed food visually distinct. Layout in ROW-MAJOR order, left to right then top to bottom:
Row 1, column 1: Two golden oval potato croquettes, one split showing fluffy potato filling, on a plate.
Row 1, column 2: Two round breaded ground-meat cutlets, one cut showing brown minced meat inside, on a plate.
Row 1, column 3: Three long golden breaded shrimp with red tails and a lemon wedge on a plate.
Row 1, column 4: Three large lightly golden fried tofu cubes with snowy daikon and scallions in amber dashi broth in a shallow bowl.
Row 1, column 5: One square chilled snow-white tofu block topped with grated ginger and scallions, little soy sauce, on a small plate.
Row 2, column 1: A bowl of soy-braised chicken chunks, distinctive lotus-root circles with holes, carrot, taro and shiitake.
Row 2, column 2: A shallow small bowl of thin brown burdock and orange carrot matchsticks, glossy sesame sprinkled kinpira.
Row 2, column 3: A neat short bundle of blanched deep-green spinach stems and leaves in a small dish, with a little bonito garnish.
Row 2, column 4: A little bowl of bright green bean segments generously coated in coarse tan ground sesame dressing.
Row 2, column 5: A small bowl of thin cucumber rings and dark wakame seaweed in clear vinegar dressing with sesame.
Row 3, column 1: A small bowl of green spinach and thin orange carrot strips covered in crumbly snowy white tofu dressing.
Row 3, column 2: Four thick orange kabocha squash wedges with dark-green rind in a little shallow bowl of clear amber broth.
Row 3, column 3: A small bowl of fine glossy dark hijiki seaweed strands mixed with orange carrot slivers and pale soybeans.
Row 3, column 4: A small bowl of pale tan thin curly dried-daikon strips, orange carrot and light-brown fried tofu strips simmered together.
Row 3, column 5: A deep bowl of Japanese oden with a thick round daikon, brown egg, triangular konjac, tubular chikuwa fishcake in broth.
